request: Fix completion telemetry so structured events retain the response correlation ID, numeric status and duration without leaking request data. Add a locally served Swagger UI showing the canonical API document.
criteria: A request completion event carries the response correlation ID and typed status/duration fields, including error paths; do not log raw request data.
The locally hosted Swagger UI loads the reviewed OpenAPI document and exposes the shorten, redirect and stats operations without a CDN.
